scope: Private candidate checkout attempt and recovery of the main worktree dependency links

candidate_gate_attempt.result: Stopped before gates because pnpm attempted to purge the linked modules directory without a TTY

recovery.result: Main worktree dependencies recreated from the local store

observed.cleanup: The private checkout was moved to the desktop trash; the main index and tracked files were not changed.

limitations: The candidate checkout used links to the main node_modules tree; its dependency preparation was not an isolated candidate setup and was discarded.
No aggregate gate ran in the private checkout, and no immutable candidate was retained.
This does not authorize staging, commit, publication, push, merge, release, or final verdict.
